plan.title: Conversion Auction Setup locks template and line items

steps.note: Start the RFQ event needed for conversion.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Create an RFQ that can be converted to an auction.
Add a product whose product and quantity fields will be checked after conversion.
Add the initial invited vendor required for publication and conversion.
Publish the RFQ so conversion is available.
Confirm the source RFQ reached a published project page.
Open the Auction Setup screen created by RFQ-to-Auction conversion.
Assert that converted product and quantity fields are read-only.
Update the invited-vendor list on the conversion setup screen.
Confirm the vendor-list update completed without an application error.
